request.name: Assess unfamiliar food safely
request.function: Provide a practical way to investigate an unfamiliar food's nutrition, toxicity and any necessary preparation, distinguishing measured findings from remaining uncertainty without requiring blind consumption.
request.conditions: I am near a mature acorn plant, object:region-0-forest-acorn-0. Close observation revealed stock and growth only. Acorn food properties remain unknown. I have two known-safe roots and no collected acorns.
request.inputs: Unknown; specify any real samples, tools or other prerequisites needed.
request.costs: Unknown; prefer low physical risk and feasible local effort.
request.effects: Obtain evidence about food safety and preparation only when supported by actual tests; do not infer safety from appearance or the request itself.

input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff.
